1. APPLY HIGH TEMPERATURE GREASE ON BACKING PLATE AS SHOWN

Apply high temperature grease to the sliding surfaces of the shoe.

3. CONNECT PARKING BRAKE CABLE TO PARKING BRAKE LEVER

(a) Install the shoe hold-down springs, cups and pins.
(b) Connect the parking brake cable to the parking brake lever at rear shoe.
